My older son suffered for a long time with recurring ear and throat infections. Every single time I brought him here, I was told everything was “normal” and no further action was needed. No proper investigation, no referral to a specialist.

Eventually, I took him to a private doctor, where it was confirmed that his tonsils and adenoids needed surgery, and both ears were affected due to repeated infections. His hearing was already at risk. This could have been prevented with earlier diagnosis and referral.

Now my younger son is showing exactly the same symptoms. I have taken him to this GP more than ten times. Each visit results in a different opinion one doctor says asthma, another says allergies, another says it’s viral. Still no clear diagnosis, no proper tests, and no specialist referral.

It feels like under the NHS system, as long as a child is breathing, everything is considered “normal.” This level of inconsistency and lack of concern is unacceptable. I would not recommend this GP practice to any parent who is serious about their child’s health.",null,[0,239]]]],[null,1765812576000000,1765812576000000,"3 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1547918139451030763/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjA1ZDFSRmRFWmhVekZtVDFjNVNXTlVSak5OVkdSSVYwWk9NVlZzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1547918139451030763/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjA1ZDFSRmRFWmhVekZtVDFjNVNXTlVSak5OVkdSSVYwWk9NVlZzUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/1547918139451030763/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjA1ZDFSRmRFWmhVekZtVDFjNVNXTlVSak5OVkdSSVYwWk9NVlZzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1547918139451030763/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjA1ZDFSRmRFWmhVekZtVDFjNVNXTlVSak5OVkdSSVYwWk9NVlZzUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1547918139451030763/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjA1ZDFSRmRFWmhVekZtVDFjNVNXTlVSak5OVkdSSVYwWk9NVlZzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1547918139451030763/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjA1ZDFSRmRFWmhVekZtVDFjNVNXTlVSak5OVkdSSVYwWk9NVlZzUlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Hani,
